description: Foroyaa search result leads to a 8 Dec article about 20 truckers arrested at Port of Banjul on alleged unlawful-gathering/disobedience/riotous-conduct charges, but the ordinary body open returned zero lines. No event record was created from the snippet.
required_followup: Seek the article body through ordinary permitted public retrieval or another independent local report; establish actual gathering date, location/participants, simultaneous crowd count, demands/target, and whether the report concerns protest rather than alleged disorder. Do not infer a 50-person event from 20 arrests.
